title: Polish Flatbread with Crispy Fried Apples
description: A sweet and crunchy Polish-inspired flatbread topped with crispy fried apples, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Slice the apples into thin wedges.
In a shallow dish, mix together sugar and crispy fried onions.
Dredge the apple wedges in the sugar mixture, coating evenly.
Heat 1/2 inch (1 cm) of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated apple wedges until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried apples to a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until caramelized.
Cut the Polish flatbread into triangles or squares.
Serve the flatbread with the crispy fried apples on top.
Garnish with additional crispy fried onions, if desired.
